sources.name: USDA FoodData Central
sources.version_policy: Record the FDC data type, download release or access date, and concrete FDC ID.

sources.name: Food and Nutrient Database for Dietary Studies
sources.version_policy: Record the exact survey release and FNDDS food code or linked FDC ID.

sources.name: Food Patterns Equivalents Database
sources.version_policy: FPED/FPID release must match the associated FNDDS/WWEIA release.

sources.name: Canadian Nutrient File
sources.version_policy: Record CNF edition and Food_Code; registry reference is Canadian Nutrient File 2026.

sources.name: Bundeslebensmittelschluessel (BLS)
sources.version_policy: Record BLS edition and product code; registry reference is BLS 4.0 (2025). Attribution is required by the CC BY 4.0 licence.

sources.name: ANSES-CIQUAL food composition table
sources.version_policy: Record CIQUAL edition and food item identifier; current registry reference is the 2025 table.

sources.name: Composition of Foods Integrated Dataset
sources.authority: UK public health food composition programme
sources.version_policy: Record the published CoFID edition and food code; registry reference is the 2021 update.

sources.name: Frida food composition databank
sources.authority: Technical University of Denmark food data service
sources.version_policy: Record download/access date and concrete food identifier.

sources.name: Norwegian Food Composition Table
sources.version_policy: Record annual table edition or retrieval date and concrete food identifier; registry reference updated January 2026.

sources.name: New Zealand Food Composition Database FOODfiles
sources.authority: Plant & Food Research and New Zealand Ministry of Health
sources.version_policy: Record FOODfiles release and concrete food record; registry reference is FOODfiles 2024.

sources.name: Manufacturer or retailer nutrition declaration
sources.version_policy: Capture product/SKU, market, URL or image reference, declared basis, and access date.

sources.name: Source-backed recipe calculation
sources.version_policy: Record ingredient source IDs, mass fractions, yield/retention assumptions and model version.

sources.name: Declared proxy or imputation model
sources.version_policy: Record donor product/source, matching rationale, adjusted fields, uncertainty and review owner.
